newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds restricted to nearby soymeal trades.
newsitem.headline: European feeds restricted to nearby soymeal trades.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market remained lacklustre on Friday, with many participants away from their desks following national holidays across much of the continent on Thursday.
Traders noted only a handful of trades in nearby Argentine soymeal pellets, with the general market expectation that prices were probably heading lower next week.

Improving prospects for the new U.S. crop looked to be outweighing those for a smaller South Amercan harvest, they said. "The feeling is we could be going down soon, but there's no panic," one trader said. --Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
